info.title: API.SH: Discogs
info.description: The Discogs API from API.SH: public Discogs data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Items for sale in the Discogs marketplace, with every filter the shop offers: keywords, a release, master, artist, label or seller, format and format details, genre, style, media and sleeve condition, ships-from country, listing currency, price range, release year range, deals, offers, photos and sleeve options; sorted by date listed, price, condition, artist, title or seller. Each listing: id, link, media and sleeve condition, seller notes, listed date, price and currency, price and shipping in the buyer's currency, availability, photos, seller (username, rating, ratings count, ships from) and the release (id, title, artists, labels with catalog numbers, format, country, released, thumbnail), with the record in `raw`. Also returns `total`, the facet counts for every filter and price buckets. By default only listings a buyer in `country` can purchase are returned, priced up to 100,000 in the buyer's currency (the shop's limit); `available_only=false` also counts the others, which the shop does not describe, in `unavailable`. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/discogs-marketplace-search

parameters.name: sleeve_condition

parameters.description: Country name(s), e.g. Germany, United States.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Listing currency code(s), e.g. EUR, GBP.

parameters.name: deals
parameters.description: Only listings the site marks as a good deal.

parameters.name: with_photos
parameters.description: Only listings with the seller's own photos.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort order (default desc for listed, price and condition).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Buyer's country (2 letters, default US): prices and shipping are shown for it.

parameters.name: available_only
parameters.description: Default true: only listings a buyer in `country` can purchase. false: count the rest in `unavailable` (their details are not served).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search the Discogs music database (releases, masters, artists, labels) by keyword or by any field: title, artist, label, genre, style, country, year, format, catalog number, barcode, track or credit. Each result has its `id`, `type`, `title`, `year`, `country`, `format`, `label`, `genre`, `style`, `catno`, `barcode`, `master_id`, `url`, community have/want counts and the record in `raw` (image links are not included). `total` is the site's match count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page (at most 200 pages).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/discogs-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords (or use the field filters below; at least one is needed).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Release country, e.g. US, UK, Germany.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: e.g. Vinyl, CD, Cassette, LP, Album.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
